cols.label: Simple lookup
cols.what: Several people each keep an object; name one person's object.

cols.label: Short list lookup
cols.what: A list pairs one to four names with tasks; name one person's task.

cols.label: Lookup among pairs
cols.what: Some people hold two objects and some one; name what a one-object person holds.

cols.label: Lookup past noise
cols.what: Boxes are filled, unrelated events follow; name what one box holds.

cols.label: Who holds it now
cols.what: A scene says who holds what; nothing moves. Then: 'Now X is holding the'.
cols.flag: The query opens with 'Now', which implies a change: the largest models answer as if something moved.

cols.group: Who has what after things move: told as a story
cols.label: Hand-offs in a story
cols.what: Objects pass between people in a short story; name who has an object at the end.

cols.group: Who has what after things move: told as a story
cols.label: Sets after hand-offs
cols.what: Each person starts with a set of objects, then two gives; name the set one person ends with.

cols.group: Who has what after things move: told as a story
cols.label: Refilled box
cols.what: A box is emptied and refilled; name its new contents.

cols.group: Who has what after things move: told as a story
cols.label: Many refills
cols.what: Boxes are emptied and refilled again and again; name one box's latest contents.

cols.group: Who has what after things move: written as code
cols.label: Variable chains
cols.what: Python variables are assigned, copied and reassigned; name what one prints.

cols.group: Who has what after things move: written as code
cols.label: Shared lists
cols.what: Two names point at one Python list that is changed, rebound or copied; name what a print shows.

cols.label: Box puzzle: prose
cols.what: Boxes are swapped, moved and refilled, written as plain sentences; name one box's contents.

cols.label: Box puzzle: script
cols.what: Boxes are swapped, moved and refilled, written as a two-speaker script; name one box's contents.

cols.label: Box puzzle: code
cols.what: Boxes are swapped, moved and refilled, written as a Python dictionary; name one box's contents.

cols.label: Box puzzle: chat
cols.what: Boxes are swapped, moved and refilled, written as chat turns; name one box's contents.

cols.label: 'You', nothing moves
cols.what: A narrator says who holds what; then a speaker says 'right now you're holding the'. Name the listener's object.

cols.label: 'I', after hand-offs
cols.what: Two people hand objects over only through I / my / you lines; a speaker says 'right now I'm holding the'.

cols.label: 'You', after hand-offs
cols.what: Two people hand objects over only through I / my / you lines; a speaker says 'right now you're holding the'. Name the listener's object.

cols.label: 'You' among three
cols.what: Three people talk and hand objects over; the line naming the listener asks what they are holding.

cols.label: Answering as yourself
cols.what: A speaker must answer with 'me', 'you' or a name, from where they stand in the conversation.

cols.group: Learning a rule from the examples
cols.label: Made-up grammar
cols.what: Examples show an invented word ending; apply it to a new invented word.

cols.group: Learning a rule from the examples
cols.label: Made-up operators
cols.what: Example equations define invented symbols; solve a new equation.

cols.group: Learning a rule from the examples
cols.label: Pattern completion
cols.what: Example lines repeat or mirror a pattern of nonsense words; continue a new line. A copy rule alone scores .26 here.

cols.group: Learning a rule from the examples
cols.label: Known facts (control)
cols.what: Real facts in the same examples-then-question layout; this column separates the layout from the learning.
